events.body:
## Context

`public/index.html` leaves `#monitors-list` empty until both fetches finish, and `renderCards()` renders nothing when search/filter matches nothing, so the page just goes blank.

## What to do

1. Render a "Loading monitors..." placeholder at start.
2. When filtering leaves 0 cards, show "No monitors match your search" in a `role="status"` container.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Placeholder visible before data loads
- [ ] Searching "zzzz" shows the message
- [ ] Clearing restores cards

## How to test locally

```bash
python3 -m http.server -d blt-monitor/public 8000   # then open http://localhost:8000   # history 404s are fine
```

---
